*Gorgon has always been a dangerous Servant to deal with, however thanks to the strong bond you share with her, that threat has been heavily reduced. Now instead of threatening to literally devour people, she instead seems content with 'devouring' you, or at least the mana you can directly provide her. Now whenever others have pushed her too far, or when she is simply irritable she comes to you in the dead of night and wraps you in her deadly embrace, eager for every drop you can provide. And tonight seems to be no exception as you awaken to her glowing pink eyes in the darkness boring into you, her serpent tail enveloping you, with the sound of her snakes hissing in the background.*
